replacements.new:
- name: Validate dictionary4 controls original-operation evidence
        id: v4-controls-evidence
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'directory-v4-controls' }}
        env:
          ADTR_V4_EVIDENCE_SUITE: directory-v4-controls
        run: python3 scripts/validate_directory_v4_controls_evidence.py --source-root .
      - name: Retain validated dictionary4 controls evidence
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'directory-v4-controls' && steps.v4-controls-evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: directory-v4-controls-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/evidence.json
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/original-raw-members-1440.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/original-raw-members-390.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/recovered-original-1440.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/recovered-original-390.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/original-result-values-1440.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-controls-validated/original-result-values-390.png
          # Only closed, post-cleanup validated data and explicit proof-empty PNGs.
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Validate dictionary4 cancel original-operation evidence
        id: v4-cancel-evidence
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'directory-v4-cancel' }}
        env:
          ADTR_V4_EVIDENCE_SUITE: directory-v4-cancel
        run: python3 scripts/validate_directory_v4_controls_evidence.py --source-root .
      - name: Retain validated dictionary4 cancel evidence
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'directory-v4-cancel' && steps.v4-cancel-evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: directory-v4-cancel-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-cancel-validated/evidence.json
          # Only closed, post-cleanup validated data and explicit proof-empty PNGs.
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Validate dictionary4 readers original-operation evidence
        id: v4-readers-evidence
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'directory-v4-readers' }}
        env:
          ADTR_V4_EVIDENCE_SUITE: directory-v4-readers
        run: python3 scripts/validate_directory_v4_controls_evidence.py --source-root .
      - name: Retain validated dictionary4 readers evidence
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'directory-v4-readers' && steps.v4-readers-evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: directory-v4-readers-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-readers-validated/evidence.json
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-readers-validated/producer-proof-cleared-1440.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-readers-validated/producer-proof-cleared-390.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-readers-validated/readonly-members-1440.png
            web/playwright-report/directory-v4-readers-validated/readonly-members-390.png
          # Only closed, post-cleanup validated data and explicit proof-empty PNGs.
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Validate dictionary4 backend evidence
